description: Environment variables, keyed by name. See [env](/truecharts-common/container/env).

additionalProperties.description: Environment variable entry by key. A scalar or null is the value, a map holds exactly one of `configMapKeyRef`, `secretKeyRef` or `fieldRef`.

configMapKeyRef.description: Use a key of a ConfigMap as value.

name.description: Name of the ConfigMap. Expanded to `<fullname>-<name>` unless `expandObjectName` is `false`.

key.description: Key in the ConfigMap whose value is used.

expandObjectName.description: Whether the name is expanded to `<fullname>-<name>`, the name of a ConfigMap of this chart. Set to `false` to use an existing ConfigMap.

secretKeyRef.description: Use a key of a Secret as value.

name.description: Name of the Secret. Expanded to `<fullname>-<name>` unless `expandObjectName` is `false`.

key.description: Key in the Secret whose value is used.

expandObjectName.description: Whether the name is expanded to `<fullname>-<name>`, the name of a Secret of this chart. Set to `false` to use an existing Secret.

fieldRef.description: Use a field of the pod as value, eg its name or IP.

fieldPath.description: Path of the field, eg `metadata.name` or `status.podIP`.

apiVersion.description: API version of the field path. Kubernetes uses `v1` when empty.
